title: Mesh, Automattic’s CRM for everyone, comes to Android
content_snippet: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app and relationship manager from Automattic is now an Android app.
summary_zh: Automattic旗下AI驱动的联系人管理与关系工具Mesh，现已推出Android版本。该应用此前已登陆iOS，旨在帮助用户更智能地管理社交关系。
key_points: Mesh是一款AI联系人管理应用

title: Why Stream ring-maker Sandbar says the future of AI wearables is voice
content_snippet: AI notetaking hardware has taken off over the past couple of years, with credit-card-sized devices, pendants, pins, and even transcribing earbuds all promising to capture your meetings and turn them into summaries and action items. Now, a whole wave of wearables — rings especially — are betting people want to capture stray thoughts and ideas the same way.  One of […]
title_zh: Stream戒指制造商Sandbar认为AI可穿戴设备的未来是语音
summary_zh: AI笔记硬件市场近年兴起，各类设备层出不穷。Sandbar公司认为，AI可穿戴设备的未来在于语音交互，其Stream戒指有望引领这一趋势。
key_points: AI可穿戴设备聚焦语音交互

title: US tries to override New York gambling laws, orders Kalshi to keep operating
content_snippet: Trump admin claims New York suing Kalshi created "market emergency."
title_zh: 美国试图推翻纽约赌博法，命令Kalshi继续运营
summary_zh: 特朗普政府声称纽约起诉Kalshi造成了“市场紧急状态”，因此下令Kalshi在纽约继续运营，试图推翻当地赌博法。
key_points: 美国联邦政府命令Kalshi继续运营
纽约州起诉引发市场紧急状态

title: AI Can’t Be Listed as Inventor on Patent Applications, Japan’s Top Court Rules
title_zh: 日本最高法院裁定AI不能列为专利申请发明人
summary_zh: 日本最高法院作出裁决，明确人工智能不能被列为专利申请的发明人。这一判决为AI相关知识产权法律提供了重要先例。
key_points: 日本最高法院裁定AI不能作为发明人
为AI知识产权法律提供先例
影响全球AI专利申请趋势

title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
content_snippet: This new funding comes after Lovable hit $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June, the startup told TechCrunch.
title_zh: Lovable确认133亿美元估值，再融资4亿美元
summary_zh: AI初创公司Lovable以133亿美元估值完成新一轮4亿美元融资。该公司在6月已达到5亿美元年化经常性收入，持续高速增长。
